about_experience_section.title: Over 20 years of experience in data center solutions
about_experience_section.description_1: We are a technology company specializing in data center services with a young and transformative spirit. We develop solutions for data center infrastructure with agility, innovation, and transparency at every stage of our service.
about_experience_section.description_2: We have over 20 years of experience in mission-critical and hyperscale environments that require high reliability and security. Furthermore, we are recognized for the constant development of our team's technical skills and processes.

items.title: Network Infrastructure
items.description: We deliver peace of mind, security, and results for mission-critical connectivity. We perform the installation and certification of all cabling.

items.title: Energy Efficiency
items.description: We create solutions to fill the spaces where airflow occurs with customized solutions and parts.

items.title: Office Installation
items.description: We perform electrical installations, lighting, masonry, layout changes, and office decoration projects.

items.title: Deployment
items.description: We deploy all network cables between the necessary positions and activate the equipment.

items.title: Smart Hands
items.description: Infrastructure management, fixes, testing, custom installations, and assistance for hardware and cabling troubleshooting.

items.title: Technical Moves
items.description: We pack and relocate equipment anywhere within the national territory.

items.title: Corpnet
items.description: Installation of network infrastructure for communication between racks and corporate network workstations.

items.title: Fitout
items.description: Infrastructure assembly and trunk cable routing for interconnecting rooms and network rows with server rows.

items.title: Commissioning
items.description: We ensure that every component or equipment interconnected to the data center infrastructure functions properly.

items.title: Containment
items.description: A service developed with the objective of reducing PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) in Data Centers.

items.title: Load Banks
items.description: Load simulation of up to 200 kW for commissioning and stress testing. Validate the thermal and electrical safety of your infrastructure with precision.

header.description: We develop data center infrastructure solutions with agility, innovation, and transparency at every stage of our service.

who_we_are_section.title: Who is Consultimer?
who_we_are_section.p1: We are a technology company with a young and transformative spirit. We develop data center infrastructure solutions with agility, innovation, and transparency at every stage of our service.
who_we_are_section.p2: We have over 20 years of experience in mission-critical and hyperscale (data center) environments that require high reliability and security. Furthermore, we are recognized for the constant development of our team's technical skills and processes.

commitments_section.title: Consultimer's Commitment.
commitments_section.p1: We exist to foster the evolution of the excellence concept wherever we are with our clients and collaborators at all times. We ensure exceptional service and contribute to large-scale sustainable development, staying updated and prepared to implement new technologies and tackle new challenges.
commitments_section.p2: We deconstruct complexity, bureaucracy, and the old-fashioned way of dealing with the market. Our main focus is to be a reference in the data center segment and show the world that, beyond quality, our purpose is to help people and always promote incredible experiences for everyone.
commitments_section.p3: We are faithful to our values; we prize equality, environmental preservation, respect for human dignity, and support for every positive idea for society.

sustainability_section.title: Consultimer’s Social and Environmental Responsibility
sustainability_section.p1: In all our processes, we act with transparency and care for the environment. We are constantly taking measures to minimize any type of impact that Consultimer Group's activities may cause to nature.
sustainability_section.p2: Our social responsibility is built on the same foundations that make up our Compliance model, which is to collaborate in building a fairer, more inclusive, and supportive society.
sustainability_section.card1_description: Continuous adoption of measures for the preservation and minimization of impacts on nature.
sustainability_section.card2_description: Solid foundations for a just society. Learn about and use our transparency channel.
